title: Reporting Layer — Strategy Options
description: Candidate Juicebox replacements for the customer-facing CDP reporting layer (~1,700 dealer tenants), compared on license/cost, per-tenant isolation, white-label, authoring, serving scale, and ops. Recommends Superset as a headless/embedded engine on an open self-hosted baseline, with Metabase Pro as an optional add-on. Owners: Alicia + Luis.
